title: Community post (1 year ago, approx date)
summary: Thanks the 40+ people who joined the School of Strategy, acknowledges partly warranted criticism of the announcement, and announces a 3-hour story time stream.
claims: Over 40 people joined the School of Strategy shortly after its announcement
He acknowledges some criticism of launching a paid offer was warranted, and aims to prove it serves the channel's goal of helping people whether they pay or not
Stories teased: why he left France, a childhood in a 'prison school', being kicked out of a gym by over-zealous staff, and eating so much he got banned from an all-you-can-eat sushi
